Independent School
DFE registered Independent School set up as a specialist alternative provision for young people aged 11-16 who have been excluded from mainstream school, have special educational needs, are ESOL / UASC or are unplaced year 11 learners.
Tuition Centre
Just Learn Tuition Centre is an Ofsted Registered Provision which is open in the evenings and on weekends. We offer support on all subjects within the National Curriculum, 11+ preparation and supporting learners to keep up with classwork or homework.
Exams Centre
JCQ Accredited examination centre providing examination entry for the following exams board: AQA, Pearson Edexcel, OCR, Cambridge and WJEC.
Charity
Just Learn Charity is a student charity which aims to support young learners. Examples of support provided is food packages, laptop donations and post 16 services such as CV writing, mock interviews and completing applications.
Child Contact Centre
Just Learn Child Contact Centre is a secure, neutral space for separated parents to connect with their children. NACCC Accredited, Enhance DBS-checked staff. Currently facilitating contact during the weekends.
Welcome to Jus'T'Learn
Just Learn was established in February 2012 as a Private Tuition Centre.
Since opening we have now developed the organisation to be known under the following categories:
Just Learn serves students within the local borough as well as students outside of the borough. Community interaction is pivotal to the success of our story so far. We aim to continue with this ethos in all of our future strategies to continually support young people.
Just Learn goes above and beyond to support each learner’s individual needs. We aim to support all students during their journey through education and support they may require outside of education including provision for mental health and wellbeing.

About Us
Welcome to Jus'T'Learn
Established in February 2012 as a Private Tuition Centre the organisation is a DFE Registered Independent School and an OFSTED Registered Private Tuition Centre. The School Comprises of sites within Mitcham and Wallington to cater for learners from all walks of life.
Just Learn has further developed to become a JCQ approved examination centre, NACCC accredited child contact centre and registered charity.
“There are high expectations for all pupils to behave well and work hard in lessons. Sometimes pupils need extra help to manage their emotions. Staff do this in a sensitive way and guide pupils back to learning as quickly as possible.” OFSTED, December 2023
Just Learn serves students within the local borough as well as students outside of the borough. Community interaction is pivotal to the success of our story so far. We aim to continue with this ethos in all of our future strategies to continually support you and your learners.
Just Learn goes above and beyond to support each learner’s individual needs. We aim to support all students during their journey through school and outside of school.
Our main purpose is to provide personalised learning experiences in order for students to achieve and work towards “Building the pathway to your future”.

Welcome Just Learn Independent School
Welcome to Just Learn Independent School which runs as a specialist Alternative Provision for young people aged 11 to 16. We work in partnership with local schools, local authorities and the wider community to deliver this service for the many learners that are in need of our specialist support.
Community interaction is pivotal to the success of our story so far. We aim to continue this ethos in all our future strategies to support you and your learners.
Here at Just Learn, we have a team of highly motivated and dedicated staff whom are committed to the academic and social development of our learners.
At Just Learn, we take pride in the content we deliver to our learners and the service we aim to provide. By having a wealth of outstanding tutors and a positive, stimulating environment, we are able to ensure that the guidance and support we offer our learners is of the highest quality.
Shaila Osman
Head of School

Welcome to Jus'T'Learn Tuition Centre
Our Private Tuition Centre has been established since February 2012. We offer courses for learners from the ages of 5 to 18. We are able to offer classroom based group tuition or tailored 1:1 tuition at our tuition centre in Mitcham, at home, library or online. We have been supporting learners from all different walks of life with successful outcomes for over 10 years.
Just Learn Tuition Centre is open in the evenings and on weekends. We offer support on all subjects within the National Curriculum. We can support with the following:
Students who may need that extra push have the opportunity to receive this from our dedicated team of tutors whom have been fully vetted, approved and are passionate about the subjects that they teach so that they can assist every student in aiming towards the next level in their subject.
We can support with a variety of different subjects from core subjects, humanities and specialist subjects such as languages and computer coding.

Safeguarding
Just Learn believes that for all children to learn they need to be physically, emotionally, spiritually and intellectually safe. We take safeguarding very seriously and all staff comply with the guidance of Keeping Children Safe in Education. This involves strong policies covering Child Protection, Behaviour and Discipline, Anti-bullying and Anti-discrimination and Educational Visits. We also have a team of specially trained staff who oversee all of our safeguarding.
If you have a concern, please contact any of the following members of our safeguarding team on 0208 648 9662:
